games.name: Kyklos
games.summary: In this turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, cities, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

games.name: Runic Prophecy
games.summary: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

games.name: 3Souls
games.summary: 3 Souls is an isometric open-world adventure set in a vast archipelago. Control three brothers with unique playstyles, explore forgotten ruins, and gather resources to build your base. Uncover the secrets of the Althmerium in a grand journey where your choices shape the fate of a shattered world.

games.name: A Vessel of Frustration
games.summary: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

games.name: A Wake Inn: Rebooked
games.summary:
They say bad things happen in Silver Inn Hotel. Strange noises. Mysterious flashing lights in the night. Weird figures slithering in the dark.

They say something is about to awake soon. Will you dare to witness it?

A Wake Inn comes for PC in Rebooked version - redesigned, adding new content, additional endings and fully animated models of enemies.

games.name: Abelina
games.summary: Explore a surreal wilderness by platforming and use timing based hits to gather resources. Break open branching paths to get to the other side of a giant world, talk to it's strange inhabitants, and try to understand the nature of this world.

games.name: Abyss of Kings
games.summary: Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

games.name: Across Crime
games.summary: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

games.name: Agro Tycoon
games.summary: Grow a farming empire from a single plot of land. Agro Tycoon is an isometric pixel art management simulator where you're not just a farmer - you're the CEO of your own agricultural operation.

games.name: Alchemic Beasts
games.summary: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

games.name: Alien Deathstorm
games.summary: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in Alien Deathstorm, the new sci-fi action horror FPS from Rebellion.

games.name: All Adrift
games.summary: Whether its end is dark or bright, create a religion for a fabricated god and perform surgery on the history of the universe. Strive to understand all things in the universe that mere humans cannot know. For now, survive like that.

games.name: American Navy Seals
games.summary: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

games.name: Amigo: The Broken Loop
games.summary: AMIGO is a first-person narrative-driven psychological thriller that follows a woman, Julien, after the death of her friend. As she investigates the mysterious Focus on Dream corporation, Julien uncovers a distorted world of memories, puzzles, and secrets – where nothing is quite what it seems.

games.name: Among the Waves
games.summary: Among the Waves is a science fiction metroidvania with platforming elements. Explore the dark corridors of the Alatyr-M fortress, diving into mysteries of religion and ancient technology. Manipulate physics with unique abilities, uncover hidden pathways, battle enemies and challenging bosses.

games.name: Anima: Song from the Abyss
games.summary: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

games.name: Annexation
games.summary: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in arcade missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

games.name: Artificial Detective
games.summary: Artificial Detective is a third-person action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl, as you fight, hack, and outsmart deadly machines to uncover why humans are gone.

games.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.summary: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

games.name: Attack Only
games.summary: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

games.name: Aware
games.summary: You will play a detective and go back to winter Peking more than seventy years ago. On the eve of the peaceful liberation of Peking, you will feel the cold, nothingness, exploration, pursuit, drama and gunshots in the process of searching for missing persons.

games.name: Bad Magpie
games.summary: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

games.name: Balance: Umbilical Wake
games.summary: Step into a fishermans recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the worlds rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your childs birth begins to reshape it.

games.name: Banquet of Nausea
games.summary: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

games.name: Bathory: Heritage of Blood
games.summary: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

games.name: Bearskull 2
games.summary: A vast open world, ruthless Vikings, powerful bosses, and an epic co-op mode – rise to the challenge!

games.name: Beaten Path
games.summary: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

games.name: Begraved
games.summary: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

games.name: Bel's Fanfare
games.summary: Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

games.name: Black Well Devil
games.summary: Ascend from the depths of hell in Black Well Devil, the stylish high-stakes platformer. Flick yourself into the air to reach higher heights, fall again and again, fight challenging bosses, and mayhaps fall in love.

games.name: Blackout: Zero Point
games.summary: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

games.name: Blazing War World
games.summary: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

games.name: Bloodmoored
games.summary: Bloodmoored is a first-person psychological horror. Revive a derelict factory by restarting its machinery. The spirits here are unpredictable: one moment they hunt you, the next they are your only key to salvation. Uncover their past to understand their motives and escape this trap alive

games.name: Born from the Soil
games.summary: Conquer the apocalypse using gritty dirt bikes and explosive ordnances in Born from the Soil, a blend of classic turn-based tactics, modern gameplay polish, and 16-bit retro charm.

games.name: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
games.summary: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

games.name: Brass & Bramble
games.summary: Brass & Bramble is a narrative deck-builder set in a steampunk Victorian age where myth and empire collide. As Avalon’s Envoy, battle the brass-forged Empire, uncover forgotten roots of myth, and journey from Ireland to Egypt, Japan, and beyond in story-driven expeditions.

games.name: Brassfang
games.summary: Explore a castle filled with monsters and sinister experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

games.name: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
games.summary: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

games.name: Broken Cycle
games.summary: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically — while you engineer their battle tactics, loot, craft and enchant their gear.

games.name: Bub
games.summary: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

games.name: Burdenfall
games.summary: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

games.name: Canyons
games.summary: Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Fight for your existence in 4 player co-op or solo, control massive Crawlers, build a settlement for survivors, and conquer this savage world!

games.name: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools. Every run serves a fresh tactical challenge.

games.name: Cat Craft
games.summary: A cozy first-person sim blending Gardening and Alchemy. Grow magical crops and mix ingredients to craft endless unique cats. Manage your Cat Café, find homes for your cats, and bring warmth, colors, and love back to the Gray world. From fluffy tails to quirky personalities, every cat is unique.

games.name: Children of Saturn
games.summary:
A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

CHILDREN OF SATURN blends first person adventure gameplay with real video recordings to tell an authentic slice of life story.

games.name: Chosen Anyway: Card Game
games.summary: Chosen Anyway is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder with permanent progression. Build your deck each run, face challenging bosses, and grow stronger as your cards scale with Ryn's RPG stats.

games.name: City of None
games.summary: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

games.name: Clock Overwhelmed
games.summary: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

games.name: Clockwork Revolution
games.summary: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

games.name: Club Defenders
games.summary: Club Defenders is the ultimate fusion of music, strategy, and action! It's up to you to protect our music from the Xilenz. Arm yourselves with powerful music-based towers, sound weapons and music instruments, sync up with your team and unleash the power of music to fend off the alien invaders.

games.name: Cold Case
games.summary: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

games.name: Conjunctivitalizer
games.summary: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

games.name: Constellations: Beyond the Edges
games.summary: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

games.name: Contact Protocol
games.summary:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

games.name: CountDown
games.summary: CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?

games.name: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
games.summary:
It's time for crazy driving, crazy adventure, and crazy money! Crazy Taxi is back and going global!

In this new high-octane adventure, follow Axel as he chases down the mysterious masked villains who stole his beloved taxi. Tackle extreme missions around the world all while earning some CRAZY money!

games.name: Cresata
games.summary: Betrayed. Imprisoned. Left to die. Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

games.name: Curse of Dominion
games.summary: Crowned for saving the king, you wield the coveted Blessing of Dominion. Command tense tactical battles, deepen companion Loyalty, evade those who would kill for your power, and watch a secret moral scale quietly reshape Elvorith’s fate.

games.name: Dance with the Moon
games.summary: A boy who hates the night meets a vampire girl who loves it. As they steal blood packs and help those in need under the cover of darkness, the two gradually fall in love. A multi-ending visual novel that gently illuminates the lives of those lost in the night and offers comfort to the lonely.

games.name: Dead Rose
games.summary: Hand-crafted 2D pixel art action-adventure. Play as Lucky, a skeleton lost in the world of spirits, and set out in search of Rose through a dark and magical world that blends Metroidvania exploration with Zelda-like adventure.

games.name: Dead Watch
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

games.name: DeadStuck
games.summary: Take on the role of a sinner fighting for absolution against hordes of the damned. Inspired by arcade light gun shooters and boomer shooters, use your quick reflexes tools of divine condemnation to come out victorious!

games.name: Delving The Depths
games.summary: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler.

games.name: Depth-Bound
games.summary: A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

games.name: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
games.summary: A text-driven noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in the text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects to solve the murder of fashion icon Margot Voss.

games.name: Dhalman
games.summary: Dhalman is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

games.name: Dice Crawler
games.summary: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

games.name: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
games.summary: The genius Hakase “Mememe”, who wants to sleep all the time, invented “Kawaii Sheep”, which induces sleep with its mysterious healing properties. This is an exponentially kawaii sheep-carrying game in which Hakase puts the whole world to sleep.

games.name: Dracula: The Disciple
games.summary: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Draculas castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

games.name: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 3
games.summary:
Step into a brand-new future Dragon ball universe filled with unique, original characters brought to life by Akira Toriyama, the original author of Dragon Ball. In Age 1000, journey through developed and vibrant West City. Explore the bustling city, encounter characters, and uncover exciting new stories.
Take your place in the story and experience what awaits in West City.
Guided into the ranks of the Great Saiyan Squad, you’ll fight alongside allies as events there begin to take shape.

games.name: Drift Boom Boom
games.summary: Drift Your way around 40+ Race Courses, BOOM Fire missiles, shotguns, and more, Boom Blow up your friends in Split-Screen. Just watch out behind you on the final lap!

games.name: Dung Slinger
games.summary: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

games.name: Dungeon4X
games.summary: Dungeon4X is a new type of game that combines 3D dungeon RPG with 4X strategy. As the guild master of an adventurer's guild, you will lead the construction of farms and workshops, build a financial base by selling products, and embark on a grand adventure to obtain the ultimate artifact!

games.name: Echoes of Midnight
games.summary: Bound. Dressed. Displayed. A serial killer's ritual has begun — and you're the centerpiece. Use silence as your weapon, solve the killer's twisted puzzle, and escape before midnight. Play solo, survive together in co-op, or become the hunter in versus mode.

games.name: Eclipse
games.summary: Three friends known as The Ghost Hunters are documenting abandoned locations. What begins as a normal episode suddenly turns into a nightmare inside The Holloway Mansion. Something terrifying happens, leaving Jack to survive alone in the mansion and face the horrors.

games.name: Elderfeast
games.summary: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

games.name: Elestrals Awakened
games.summary:
In a world shaped by Gods and Titans, the elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. As darkness stirs and conflict brews among the realms, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise.

Elestrals Awakened is 2.5D single-player action-adventure, monster tamer RPG video game that puts you at the center of the Elestrals Universe. Step into the role of a Caster, forge a bond with a Spirit companion, and explore the elemental lands as tensions rise and ancient powers awaken!

games.name: Empty Box
games.summary: Psychological horror dating sim for women. Navigate a seemingly perfect school life where every sweet moment hides a lie. Why is the rooftop locked? Why is *they* so obsessed? Why only ‘L’? Your choices shape the truth—and every move is watched. Discover chilling endings.

games.name: End of Eden
games.summary: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

games.name: End the Endless
games.summary: End the Endless is a dark fantasy turn based RPG set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness unique directional based weapon systems in an oppressive environment. Utilize unique abilities, items and even your party members as a resource. Explore the Afterlife and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

games.name: Endless Samurai
games.summary: "Endless Samurai" is a roguelite that overcomes death and becomes stronger. You can experience a new battle system aiming at "fusion of turn-based and speedy action".

games.name: Entity: Unknown
games.summary: Choose your side in the confrontation between the nightmare spawns and the SSA organization in an asymmetric multiplayer horror game. Spread the miasma of fear, become a real font of horror and plunge the Hunters into a madness, or plunge into an atmosphere of intense horror together with friends.

games.name: Epoch Reset
games.summary: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

games.name: Eternity
games.summary:
An unforgettable journey of discovery, hope, and survival, as you strive to unlock the secrets of the universe and pave the way for humanity's destiny.

By intertwining Exploration, Adaptive Gameplay, and Survival, ETERNITY offers a rich and immersive experience where you’re guiding humanity’s last fleet through a procedurally generated galaxy, and your “empire” is a moving city of ships. Every vessel is both a building and a lifeline. You’ll expand by salvaging and refitting new ships, exploit resources across systems, and face moral and political decisions that can shape the fleet’s future.

games.name: Everhood Hunters
games.summary: Everhood's musical combat a la Roguelite! ⚔️ Easy to play but hard to master. Join up with a friend in co-op to conquer the spiraling madness straight from the minds of Everhood's creators.

games.name: Everything Is Gun!
games.summary: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Exodus is an epic new sci-fi action-adventure RPG franchise developed by the team at Archetype Entertainment. The story is fueled by the consequences of player choices due to the impact of Time Dilation and how they change the lives of those we love most.

games.name: Falling Apart
games.summary: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

games.name: Feed the Giants
games.summary: You are a giant guiding a group of lost children through a hostile world. Help them… or sacrifice them to entertain your kind, who watch the spectacle from above. Some want to see them thrive, others crave their suffering. Every choice has its price.

games.name: Flesh & Wire
games.summary: Flesh & Wire is a first-person shooter that delves into the psychological horror roots of the POSTAL series. Venture into this twisted reality as Angel, a hapless victim suddenly swept up in a fever dream of conspiracy and blood as she seeks answers and vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

games.name: Forgery Craft
games.summary: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

games.name: Fortune and Glory
games.summary: Fortune & Glory is a text-parser action RPG about leaving home to become a hero! Decide who you are as you explore an ailing world in a detailed retro-inspired style. Gain help from your personalities and their internal dialogue to solve puzzles and fight monsters in a realtime battle system.

games.name: Frame of Suffering
games.summary: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi ARPG Roguelite. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

games.name: From Ruins
games.summary: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

games.name: Frostpunk: 1886
games.summary: The original Frostpunk experience is being reimagined and expanded with new events, mechanics, and laws within a new Purpose Path. Return to your role as the ruler of Earth's last city, manage its citizens, weigh up your choices and ensure your society's survival.

games.name: Gabby's Odyssey
games.summary: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

games.name: Gambit
games.summary: Chess game about beating strongest chess engine, but in roguelike style

games.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
games.summary: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in treacherous free-for-all multiplayer. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm. Do you have the strength to seize the Iron Throne?

games.name: Gigantic Maidestruction
games.summary: A giant maid wreaks havoc on the city under the pretext of defeating enemies! Gigantic Destruction Action Game!

games.name: Girlfailure Art Club
games.summary: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

games.name: Glintseeker Island
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, uncover exciting secrets, excavate countless treasures, and fight enemies and bosses. Save the island from a mysterious threat below!

games.name: Go Phish
games.summary: Go Fish or go homeless. In this rogue-ish debt-builder, pay your rent by phishing a target in a supercharged version of the classic card game. Crack your victims password in a dynamic dialogue system, then use your loadout of unlockable suits and items to hack their PC and drain their savings.

games.name: Goblin Cleanup
games.summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

games.name: Gravity Circuit 2
games.summary: A new Ark has risen. Switch between the Gravity and Power Circuit in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit

games.name: Greed Hunters
games.summary: Earn rewards for your greed in this chaotic, multiplayer rogue-like game. Explore randomly generated dungeons with up to 8 players in a world where greed is the currency. To survive, you must outsmart and out-hoard your teammates.

games.name: Guild Wars 3
games.summary: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder. Play solo or form a band of adventurers, forging impactful and enduring bonds with fellow players, a formative cast of memorable NPCs, and the nature spirits that call Orr home.

games.name: Gundam Rogue Orbit
games.summary: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

games.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 3
games.summary: The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back! Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders! His trusty partner Lola is there to support him with evolutionary new modes!

games.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Magnetrix
games.summary: Assemble magnetic towers by stacking pieces from opposite poles, to enlighten a electrifying hexagonal board.

games.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
games.summary: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Hemlon the Grey
games.summary: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

games.name: Herd
games.summary:
Herd is a cute-but-competitive tactical card battler set in a magical musical world.
Build your deck, and face your rival in fast strategic duels where every card you play becomes part of a live musical performance.

But victory is not about reducing health points.

In Herd, you win by converting the Mélodus — adorable divine creatures who react to music, magic and momentum. Read your opponent, control the stage, trigger powerful synergies, and turn the crowd before your rival does.

games.name: Heretic Red
games.summary: In an isolated, snowy village, a detective monk must solve a series of bizarre murders. Collect evidence, unravel the truth, and expose killers. In this tight-knit community, every resident is a friend and a suspect. As the body count rises, you must use everything you have to stop the bloodshed.

games.name: Heroes of the Underworld
games.summary: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

games.name: Herosbine: The Unknown Island
games.summary: A story-driven open world, action-adventure RPG set on a mysterious island where the player takes on the role of Tim. Tim is living a normal life as a geeky, introverted boy. He is struggling with his identity and the loss of his best friends, and feels out of place.

games.name: Hidden Folks 2
games.summary: Search for hidden folks in interactive miniature landscapes. Scare some giraffes, ride a few rides, appreciate some art, and push around some astronauts. Wheeeeeeee!!!

games.name: Hole War: The Abyss
games.summary: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

games.name: Humblets
games.summary: Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. No pressure, just peaceful exploration and fireside stories!

games.name: Hunter White
games.summary: White Hunt is a 2.5D open sandbox co-op hunting game. Every weapon features unique branching attack chains. Mix and match countless talismans to forge your exclusive combat style!

games.name: Hyper Tanks
games.summary: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in action-packed multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

games.name: Häxeri
games.summary: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

games.name: I Hear the Forest
games.summary: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

games.name: I Shall Name the Dead
games.summary: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

games.name: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
games.summary: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

games.name: Ignifugo
games.summary: Ignifugo is a top-down action roguelite with auto-battler elements. Control a combat shell and modify it with auto-attacking units. Take advantage of class bonuses, items and abilities to create unique builds as you fight heated battles through five biomes. Will you survive or be reduced to ash?

games.name: Ill
games.summary: Unleash your survival instincts. Step into the sinister town, face a growing horror and uncover the unsettling truth behind the town's descent into madness. Are you ready to confront your deepest fears?

games.name: Incoherence: Dark Rooms
games.summary: Dark Rooms is a survival horror room-drafting game set in a looping nightmare. Expand the map by placing rooms at the cost of stability. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, manage limited resources, and unlock new rooms and upgrades. Every run is a new descent into darkness.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Ink Shapes: Book One
games.summary: Rotate stamps to create beautiful watercolor paintings in this relaxing hand-drawn puzzle.

games.name: Insomnia Club
games.summary: Insomnia Club is a dark, grounded emotional visual novel about early-adult confusion, social issues, intimacy, and self-identity. You play as a long-term insomniac employee whose life gradually slips out of control as reality tightens around you.

games.name: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet
games.summary: Set thousands of years in the future, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet puts players into the role of Jordan A. Mun, a dangerous bounty hunter who ends up stranded on Sempiria – a distant planet whose communication with the outside universe went dark hundreds of years ago. Jordan will have to use all her skills and wits if she hopes to be the first person in over 600 years to leave its orbit.

games.name: Into The Unwell
games.summary: Dive into The Unwell as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits in this delightfully despondent third-person roguelite game, playing alone or with up to two friends.

games.name: Into the Dust
games.summary: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

games.name: Into the Void
games.summary: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

games.name: Iron Bramble
games.summary: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

games.name: Island Keeper
games.summary: Breathe new life into forgotten islands. Pick up trash, recycle it, craft items, and build your own base. As you heal the land, it flourishes into a wild paradise. Explore by walking, riding a boat, or using a submarine, and change a world that reacts to everything you do!

games.name: Ismene
games.summary: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

games.name: It Breathes
games.summary: First-person VHS horror game set in an abandoned Hungarian hospital. Hide, fight, or flee while working towards your only goal: to escape.

games.name: Itachi: Haunted Abodes - Wandering Through 2000s Tokyo Culture
games.summary: Itachi: Hunted Abodes is a paranormal suspense adventure that has you wandering through 2000s Tokyo's subculture scenes!

games.name: Ithaca
games.summary: Ithaca is a narrative road-trip with RPG elements about environmental resistance. You play as Penelope, a young environmental rights lawyer, as she drives towards the most important decision she'll ever have to make.

games.name: Jay and Silent Bob's: Joint Venture
games.summary: After Jay and Silent Bob sell you a bad dimebag, you help New Jersey’s legendary slackers take their operation from a rundown backyard to the best operation in the tri-state area in this gleefully obscene cozy farming adventure.

games.name: Just in Crime
games.summary: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

games.name: Justice Project
games.summary: Manage your very own operational courthouse, show your architectural talent, with every detail in your control. Let your management prowess show, schedule cases and trials alongside the ever present pressures of profit and reputation.

games.name: Kemuri
games.summary: Kemuri summons you into a realm where the unpredictable meets the extraordinary in an urban jungle where mysterious creatures - Yokai- hide amongst the population. Become a Yokai Hunter and use your Fox Window to unravel the mysteries of the city and bring balance to the world. Dive into a thrilling adventure alone or with friends, hunt yokai in style, collect their powers and face even greater challenges.

games.name: Keyboard Smash
games.summary:
Keyboard Smash is a fully voice acted story driven comedy game about running a small store while the characters around you are too stupid for their own good.
Help strange and random customers, travel to many bizarre locations, and make choices that turn the story upside down.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Killing Baby Hitler
games.summary: Stop fascism in the cradle. Travel through time and hunt down history’s most evil infant in this satirical old-school FPS.

games.name: Kimbap Factory
games.summary: Automate the ultimate Korean kitchen. Route belts, watch ingredients transform, and physically assemble each kimbap roll step by step. Discover new recipes, fulfill requests, and expand your kitchen at your own pace. No pressure, no timers, just a satisfying and unique casual factory experience.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts IV
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts IV follows protagonist Sora and some familiar characters as they journey through the mysterious city of Quadratum. Sora will once again journey to various worlds, where new figures cross his path and new powers awaken in this next chapter.

games.name: Kint
games.summary:
Kint is a modern version of the classic MUD RPGs. Set in the fictional world of Seram, players are researchers tasked with exploring and learning all they can about the world and it's mysterious kilns.

Players collect lore fragments, which often contradict which each other and the established canon and must submit and vote what should be marked as the truth each week.

games.name: Knuckle Paradise
games.summary: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

games.name: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
games.summary: A haunting Thai horror adventure. Play as Kumarn, a wandering spirit lost in a world of terrifying folklore and vengeful ghosts. With only his courage and loyal spirit steed, he must face his fears and search for a place called home.

games.name: Labyren
games.summary: Labyren is a medieval-themed Tower Defense game centered on multi-waypoint mazing and vision. While traversing through the campaign, discover countless unique strategies building with your ever-expanding arsenal and unravel the story underneath!

games.name: LavaLoop
games.summary: LavaLoop is a music-driven shoot'em up, in a hand-drawn Steampunk universe. Face a mad queen and destroy the planet killing machine. Play as three musician fighters and jump from surprise to surprise in this unique fantasy universe.

games.name: Legend of Bakehime
games.summary: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

games.name: Light of Motiram
games.summary: Light of Motiram is an open-world survival game where you explore a world overrun by colossal machines, explore the vast open world, build your base of operations, advance technology, train Mechanimals, and take on formidable bosses. Starting from the primitive age, forge a new path of development. Defy the machination, survive with mechanimals.

games.name: Lilith
games.summary: Every head is a world. Lilith is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

games.name: Liquid Lungs
games.summary: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

games.name: Lock In
games.summary: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

games.name: Long Gone
games.summary: Decades after the outbreak, you play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and uncover secrets as you search for supplies in this 2.5D pixel puzzle platformer inspired by adventure games of old.

games.name: Lootspire
games.summary: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

games.name: Lunar Pulse
games.summary: That night, thirteen witches devour each other. "Lunar Pulse" is a single-player roguelite card game. Under eternal moonlight, a ritual for life and death unfolds. Play simultaneously with hands revealed. One move invites instant death—soulslike tension in every card battle.

games.name: MKS: Model Kit Studio
games.summary: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

games.name: Machina of the Farthest
games.summary: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

games.name: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
games.summary: Magicians: The Devils Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

games.name: Mama
games.summary:
An emotional narrative point-and-click about a daughter caring for her mother as dementia reshapes their bond. Explore heartfelt conversations, fragmented memories, and story-driven puzzles on a journey of caregiving and learning to let go.

Love is heavy. Care is relentless. Watching someone you love fade is a quiet, piercing heartbreak you can’t prepare for. In this game, you step into the shoes of a daughter, moving through a world shaped by dementia - not to solve it, not to fix it, but to live it, feel it, and carry it alongside the one you love. Every gesture, every pause, every choice matters.

Gameplay isn’t a distraction - it is the story. Simple, deliberate interactions and inventive puzzles put you inside moments of tenderness, confusion, and heartbreak. Seven chapters guide you through caregiving’s emotional terrain: the exhausting patience, the fragile joys, and the quiet sorrow of learning when to hold on - and when to let go.

Dementia is at the heart of the experience, shaping every conversation, memory, and interaction. Each day reveals shifting moods and fractured recollections, blurring the line between truth and misremembering. As the mother’s world becomes more fragile and uncertain, the gameplay mirrors her fading clarity — guiding you through moments of confusion, tenderness, and the quiet heartbreak of watching someone slip away.

games.name: Man I Just Wanna Live
games.summary: Mia wakes up with a hangover and a dead body in her apartment. Unfortunately, the body has friends who are about to break in through the front door. From there, things only get worse. This "MSPaint-noir" VN with 16 endings is as stylish as it is relentless. Mia just wants to live! Well, who doesn’t?

games.name: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
games.summary:
This narrative-driven ensemble game stars Captain America Steve Rogers, Black Panther Azzuri (T'Challa's grandfather), U.S. soldier and member of the Howling Commandos Gabriel Jones, and leader of the fledgling Wakandan Spy Network, Nanali.

All four characters will be playable at different parts of the story. According to Skydance, players can look forward to "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new glob-trotting adventure."

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: MegaGum
games.summary: Play as Uja in this 3D bubble-punk platformer blending action and adventure. Jump, glide, fight, and walk on walls using your Gum-powered abilities. Outsmart the traps of the mysterious Mister Gum and climb floor by floor through a factory filled with secrets, puzzles, and surprises.

games.name: Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
games.summary: Melty Blood: Type Lumina is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

games.name: Memoria Wake
games.summary: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

games.name: Midnight Souls
games.summary: Explore the mysteries of the small town of Camomile Peaks! Date the girl of your dreams, fight your enemies, and make socially acceptable friends in this dark humor-flavored RPG. And keep your cat, Charlie, out of trouble!

games.name: Midnight Train: New Moon
games.summary: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

games.name: Might of Fate
games.summary: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

games.name: Mimi's Restaurant helper
games.summary: 2000's anime style restaurant game meets Wario ware , a game about making dishes and multitasking but with cute 2D art and beautiful bossanova music, Chaotic meets Cozy

games.name: Mirror Land
games.summary: This is an optical illusion space puzzle game with an original core mechanism. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.

games.name: Misdecayed
games.summary: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots.

games.name: Misha
games.summary: Play as a hacker backing up Misha—whose brain has been transplanted into a sexyroid—as you face off against all threats that stand in your way in this cyberpunk FPS.

games.name: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
games.summary: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

games.name: Monji
games.summary: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. Monjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

games.name: Monster Girl Clinic
games.summary: Welcome to Monster Girl Clinic. You arrive as a patient — but something here isn't adding up. Get to know the clinic's unusual staff, follow the clues, and uncover what's really going on, in a story-driven visual novel of mystery, romance, and monster girls.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
games.summary: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!

games.name: Moon Doom
games.summary: Boomer shooter metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast the your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

games.name: MoonHack
games.summary: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

games.name: Moosa: Dirty Fate
games.summary:
MOOSA: Dirty Fate is a dark action game inspired by Korean history. "MOOSA" meaning is a person who has mastered martial arts and works in that field.

MOOSA: Dirty Fate is an action game based on the story of MOOSAs' revenge, responsibility, and ambition, centered on 17th-century Korea.

Face terrifying monsters, uncover the truth behind a cursed fate, and fight to save your people.

games.name: Mori
games.summary: Experience lightning-fast combat as Mori, a grieving widow on a quest for revenge. Armed with nothing but a scythe and cloak, carve your way through countless foes, dismantle a criminal empire, and discover what it means to lose yourself.

games.name: Motorsport Manager 2
games.summary: The world of motorsport returns in the next evolution of the ultimate motorsport management sim. Compete in multiple series, master deeper strategy than ever before, and lead your team to victory on and off the track. Build your racing legacy.

games.name: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
games.summary: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

games.name: My Cannibal Family
games.summary: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

games.name: My Dear Emma
games.summary: Exploring beautiful landscapes and local wildlife. Become part of Emma’s story, a young biologist and nature photographer who has decided to start a new life far from the big city. A narrative-driven adventure to relax, feel, and slow down.

games.name: My Time at Evershine
games.summary: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

games.name: My Wife is a Princess
games.summary: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

games.name: N Plus Infinity Times Two
games.summary: 5 fresh flavors of world-class online mayhem, from Friendship-Testing Co-op to Friendship-Ending Competitive, plus classic singleplayer. Run around with friends, lure enemies into opponents, make the ultimate sacrifice for teammates, and hunt each other with rockets. Couch-ready/Tournament-worthy.

games.name: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
games.summary: When the war between the Enhanced and ordinary humans shatters the future, turning back time becomes humanity's final gamble. As a life scientist navigating two timelines, you must decide: force genetic equality or embrace natural selection? No matter your choice, someone will pay the price.

games.name: Necrofane
games.summary: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

games.name: Neebota: Zeebo's Awakening
games.summary: An open world party-based RPG set in an original fantasy world called Neebota, where Zeebo and his friends hunt for portals from our earth, and in doing so, uncover secret powers, ancient lore of their world and a vast conspiracy across space and time.

games.name: Neko's Rage
games.summary: 2D pixelart action game with many roguelite mechanics and power up. The gameplay is speed and hardcore but very addictive. You play as Nikki a female cyborg in an apocalyptic world rules by mechanicals creatures.

games.name: Nexus Code
games.summary: NEXUS CODE is a 3D programming battle game that reimagines the excitement of the "hobby anime" and "competitive toys" that captivated many children in the 90s and 2000s, using modern programming elements. Build your own unique character and challenge rivals with logical thinking as your weapon.

games.name: Nightmare Journey 1135
games.summary: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

games.name: No Signal: Chornobyl
games.summary: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

games.name: No Walls in Heaven
games.summary: No Walls In Heaven is a first-person exploration platformer about losing yourself in the hostile vastness of the cosmos. Grapple, leap, and fight your way through the towering concrete and metal landscapes of a lost megastructure that seems to disobey all laws of physics and reality.

games.name: Noir Bloom
games.summary: Noir Bloom is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

games.name: Nova Assault
games.summary:
Extraction-based first-person shooter designed to deliver a realistic, immersive experience. With its own economy and internal progression system, Nova Assault challenges you with thrilling trials and missions in diverse, highly detailed environments.

Prepare for intense firefights, survival-driven strategies, and explore a world teeming with opportunities, dangers, and precious resources.

games.name: OCRPG
games.summary: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

games.name: Oath Eternal
games.summary: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

games.name: October Nightmares
games.summary: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

games.name: Omega Phenex Commenced Project Six
games.summary: You will become a pilot of the mech “Icarus,” which has tremendous maneuverability. You will enjoy a fight and face large powerful armies and rivals by moving from skimming the surface of the sea to the cloud with Icarus. This game is a high-speed mech shooting game capable of firing massive amounts of missiles.

games.name: Ontos
games.summary: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

games.name: Orbital Drift
games.summary: Explore drifting wrecks orbiting a dead planet. Master orbital mechanics. Fight zero gravity in space. Gather resources and build modules. Upgrade your ship to travel further. Uncover a civilization’s downfall. Are people on Earth ready to learn its history?

games.name: Ork
games.summary: One day, a mighty quake shakes the land — Colors fade away, this wasn't planned! “This is bad!” cry five odd friends in stride, They gather, rise, and run side by side. Use their skills, push through each stage, Reach the goal in a 2D side-scrolling rage!

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Own Time Own Target
games.summary: Own Time Own Target drops two players into a divided battlefield in a pure 2D 1v1 where reading the environment is just as important as outgunning your opponent. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Friendships not guaranteed.

games.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
games.summary: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

games.name: Pact of the Black Tide
games.summary: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Panic 64
games.summary: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

games.name: Papaya Plaza
games.summary: Papaya Plaza is a snackable slice of life game for you to get lost in. Decorate and improve the town as you see fit, to make a perfect little spot for visitors to wander and enjoy. These beeps aren't picky, they just want to discover the next best-kept-secret!

games.name: Perceptum
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

games.name: Phantasist
games.summary: Phantasist是一款體驗社恐生活的遊戲！

games.name: Pikuniku 2
games.summary: Absurd puzzle-exploration adventure Pikuniku 2 brings the whimsy! Wander, solve, and gossip your way through a weird and wonderful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Protect the potato!

games.name: Pilot 6174: Orbital Survival
games.summary: Navigate star systems using real orbital mechanics. Pilot a cockpit with controls inspired by the Apollo command module. Manage heat, energy, and trajectory.

games.name: Pine Creek
games.summary: A weekend getaway to Pine Creek in '86 turns into a nightmare when your wife vanishes as strange lights appear in the sky. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays, save Sarah and survive the night in this first-person stealth survival horror. The truth is darker than you think.

games.name: Pokémon Waves
games.summary: Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves are upcoming role-playing video games developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company for the Nintendo Switch 2. Announced on 27 February 2026, on the franchise's 30th anniversary, they are the first installments in the tenth generation of the Pokémon video game series and the first to be exclusively available on the Switch 2. They are set to release in 2027.

games.name: Pokémon Winds
games.summary: Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves are upcoming role-playing video games developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company for the Nintendo Switch 2. Announced on 27 February 2026, on the franchise's 30th anniversary, they are the first installments in the tenth generation of the Pokémon video game series and the first to be exclusively available on the Switch 2. They are set to release in 2027.

games.name: Project Tal
games.summary: An open-world action Korean mythology RPG. Players will explore a detailed and in-depth world across a single-player adventure inspired by ancient folklore that reimagines Korea’s traditional Tal masks. Engage with an array of threats from massive monsters to formidable swordsmen, making use of enemy weak points, counterattacks, unique abilities, and more.

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.summary: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” You're a passenger on a transcontinental train. Looking for a room that's nowhere to find: Cabin 909.

games.name: R.override
games.summary: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a run-based mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

games.name: Radiant Sky
games.summary: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

games.name: Ragnarok Console Project
games.summary:
Ragnarok Console Project is a new RPG based on the world of Ragnarok, a legendary intellectual property enjoyed by over 100 million players worldwide.

Set in a familiar yet completely reimagined world, players will confront a collapsing reality and the hidden truths buried within it.

Choices and consequences. A journey from which there is no turning back.

games.name: Re:Aktor
games.summary: Re:Aktor is a metroidvania about going fast and rewinding time. Race the clock, unlock new abilities and shortcuts, and solve temporal puzzles. Tear through walls and enemies with damage that scales with momentum, and punch ever deeper into a mysterious underground facility.

games.name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
games.summary: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

games.name: Regions
games.summary:
Regions is a agent-first city builder focused on infrastructure, procedural growth, and living city systems. Build roads, shape districts, manage transportation, and watch thousands of agents move through a region where every connection, event, and decision helps shape the city’s future.

Regions is a single-player city-building and regional management simulation focused on infrastructure, transportation, development, and the people who use them.

games.name: Resident Evil Veronica
games.summary: Claire Redfield returns to the forefront in this remake of the title originally released on the Dreamcast in 2000 and the following year on PlayStation 2. This new version preserves the essence of the original game while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.

games.name: Rhythm Doggo
games.summary: You wanted to play a video game and just got transformed into a dog! Rhythm Doggo is a classic platform adventure where you play as a dog and make music on the way. Can you go back to your human form?

games.name: Ringwyrm
games.summary: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.summary: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

games.name: SandEEE
games.summary: Write code for an alternate universe in SandEEE, just keep in mind "EEE sees all".

games.name: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter
games.summary:
Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space
A stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Beautifully unsettling.

games.name: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
games.summary: Satoyama note Spring walk is a point-and-click visual novel in which you aim to reach your destination while identifying plants in a satoyama in spring. Listen to the animals, observe and identify the plants as you make your way through the forest, and have lunch under the cherry blossom trees!

games.name: Save Humanity.exe
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder based around designing a microchip from a pile of junk circuits to out compute incoming viruses trying to crash your system. Combo hardware with software programs to chain multipliers that overflow your FLOP meter before the glitches overwhelm you.

games.name: Scorched Earth
games.summary: Scorched Earth is a chunky PS2 mecha-action game with massive amounts of customization, where you play as a mercenary taking on dirty jobs across a planetary war.

games.name: Sea of Remnants
games.summary: Sea of Remnants is an original ocean adventure RPG developed by Joker Studio. Your journey begins as a puppetfolk sailor who has lost their memory. Alongside a mysterious girl, you’ll set sail on a chaotic and colorful voyage—one filled with treasure, conflict, dreams, and unexpected companions. As the seas stretch endlessly before you, an epic world of myth and history slowly unfolds. But beware, Captain: fall overboard, and your mind may be swallowed by the very thing this ocean was named for—forgetting.

games.name: Self Simulated
games.summary: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer for the Game Boy Color. Play as a robotic version of yourself and navigate over 100 handcrafted levels filled with enemies, hazards, and glitch-filled dangers. Uncover your past and master tight, responsive controls designed for fast retries and fluid movement.

games.name: Self-Replication: Destruction
games.summary: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

games.name: Senua
games.summary: A Celtic warrior is trapped between life and death in a fractured vision of purgatory. In an action‑adventure set in the Hellblade universe, Senua fights to reach the afterlife and reunite with those she loved and lost, battling forces that threaten all she believes in.

games.name: Sepak U: Sports Fighting Game
games.summary: Smash-Like Volleyball - Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss battles. Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport.

games.name: Settle
games.summary: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

games.name: Shadows of Eldemir
games.summary: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

games.name: Shell Bless the Faithless
games.summary: Shell Bless the Faithless is a 3rd Person Roguelite Shooter supporting 1~4 players where you take on the role of a Norse warrior. In a chaotic world where runes, magic, and shotguns coexist, evolve with the blessings of the gods, crush heretical foes and their leaders, and rebuild a macho world!

games.name: Shironeko Project Infinity
games.summary: Shironeko New Project is a co-op action RPG based on the mobile game Shironeko Project but will have a new story with new characters.

games.name: Sin or Suffer
games.summary: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

games.name: Situation Normal
games.summary: A single-player shoot-'em-up precision platformer.

games.name: Slot Machine Gun
games.summary: Slot Machine Gun is a roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

games.name: Some Puzzles
games.summary: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

games.name: Soverain: An Eternal Legend
games.summary: Eternal Legend is a turn-based tactical RPG that blends political drama and family destiny. Build your army, forge bonds, and wage epic pixel art battles in a world torn apart.

games.name: Sovereign's Enigma
games.summary: Sovereign's Enigma is a 2D platformer with survival elements, in a densely interconnected cave, where the player needs to uncover the story of an ancient civilization to solve a mystery from the past. This game is a slow and immersive experience, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and characters.

games.name: Space Hauler
games.summary: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

games.name: Space Hood
games.summary: Defend your outpost in this tower defense with a raiding twist. Battle the ruthless Nova Roma Corporation as you build, loot, and survive relentless assaults.

games.name: Space Scum
games.summary: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

games.name: Spar Kart
games.summary: Spar Kart is a free-to-play racing fighting game that combines casual racing gameplay with competitive fighting game mechanics. The game offers a unique blend of casual fun with friends and intricate combat that's both accessible to newcomers and deep enough for competitive players.

games.name: Spell Breakers
games.summary: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

games.name: Spirefall
games.summary: The wars are fake. The grudges are real. A roguelite deckbuilder set in the taverns of Spirefall — win the Gauntlet, build your caravan, and conquer the greatest tables in the realm. One card at a time. Probably after questioning the stew.

games.name: Sprkls.exe
games.summary: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.

games.name: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier
games.summary: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier is a story-driven, action-adventure set in the expansive Star Trek universe. Step into the fractured mind of former Lieutenant Ro Laren (voiced by Michelle Forbes) as she seeks to rescue an old friend by embarking on a harrowing journey of survival and self-discovery.

games.name: Stardream
games.summary: Stardream is a story-driven investigation game set in a retro 60s-inspired space ark. As Darlene, a taxi driver turned into a reluctant investigator, uncover a hidden truth that could shatter a perfect society.

games.name: Starshard Brigands
games.summary: Starshard Brigands is a first-person dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, where shifting loyalties and hard choices shape your fate. As a nameless mercenary in a fractured world, decide where you stand—or stand alone.

games.name: State of Decay 3
games.summary: Unite to survive: push back the blood plague to reclaim the land's resources and carve out a life in the zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Steel Princess
games.summary: A Souls‑like 3D action game starring a spirited princess. Defeat powerful foes scattered across the open field to unlock new skills, grow stronger, and keep pressing forward!

games.name: Sticks and Stones
games.summary: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid (or asteroids) impact.

games.name: Summer Snow.
games.summary: Escape the endless midsummer in this time-loop mystery visual novel. Find the "exit key," solve the cryptic MAZE app's missions, and reach the future with your childhood friends! A coming-of-age drama with stunning visuals, a 300k-character voiced script, diverse puzzle mechanics, and no bad ends.

games.name: Sunset Suckerpunch
