games.summary: Meet K8E: a talking, transforming motorcycle-sword-gauntlet. Drive her to meet your enemies, and wield her to crater them into the asphalt. Don't let them take her voice, too.

games.name: Sunset Survival: Miami
games.summary: Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

games.name: Susuki Kaidan
games.summary: A first-person survival horror set in the dying fields of Sengoku Japan. To reach Kyoto and escape the war, a lone survivor must cross endless fields of susuki grass while the White Ghost watches from within.

games.name: Switcheroo
games.summary: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

games.name: Tambourine
games.summary: A priestess is hired to exorcize an apartment building with a Tambourine. Parry and torment ghosts in this first-person survival horror as you make your way up the building. Find the mementos that will allow you to complete the exorcism.

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: The Book of Prosperity
games.summary: A 2D Action RPG set in a surreal pixel-art world where ancient magic seeps through Hong Kong-inspired streets. Pulled into a parallel dimension ruled by the Circle, Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and forbidden truths to uncover the cost of a world built on false prosperity.

games.name: The E-Collector
games.summary: Clean the world, save the future. Join Ekko the robot on a quest to restore a polluted planet. Explore toxic realms, solve eco-puzzles, and battle mutated foes. Upgrade EcoVac 3000, rescue endangered creatures, and transform each region. Enjoy fully included features in this epic eco-adventure!

games.name: The End of the World Club
games.summary: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

games.name: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
games.summary: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

games.name: The Fatum
games.summary: This situation is temporary, but it comes with a strict protocol that you must follow. Morality and cold calculation intertwine in a dark tale. You are an investigator, and your arrival marks a turning point in the lives of those you encounter.

games.name: The Free Shepherd
games.summary: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

games.name: The God Slayer
games.summary: The God Slayer is an open-world action RPG featuring a highly immersive gameplay system and story experience, allowing players to enhance their abilities through battles and world exploration with the ultimate goal of defeating enemies and saving the world.

games.name: The Last General
games.summary: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

games.name: The Lift
games.summary: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

games.name: The Lost Froglins
games.summary: What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again. A roguelite side-scroller.

games.name: The Lost Wild
games.summary: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

games.name: The Money Man
games.summary: A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

games.name: The Pactmaker
games.summary: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.

games.name: The Pines
games.summary: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

games.name: The Standard Model
games.summary: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

games.name: The Talos Principle III
games.summary: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

games.name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
games.summary:
The year is 1896. The Martian invasion wipes cities and entire civilizations out of existence. Separated from his loved ones, a young student escapes the capital city already conquered by the aliens.
Along with the player, he will have to survive in the distinctive and dangerous Siberia, stand against the forces of the old world, and inevitably confront its new masters.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
games.summary:
Songs of the Past is a brand-new full-fledged expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of all time.

Created in partnership with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising veteran The Witcher 3 developers, players can once again take on the role of Geralt of Rivia and embark on a brand-new adventure before heading out on the Path as Ciri in the upcoming The Witcher 4.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
games.summary: The Wolf Among Us 2 is an episodic graphic adventure game. It is a sequel to The Wolf Among Us and takes place six months following the events of the first game. Follow Bigby Wolf in a new story filled with not-so-colorful characters from famous fairy tales.

games.name: They Speak From the Abyss
games.summary:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

games.name: Threat Vector
games.summary: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

games.name: Tidebound
games.summary: Tidebound is a fishing and inventory management game with a relaxing, casual atmosphere. Catch, sell, upgrade your boat, and sail further to catch more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

games.name: Ties: Soul Link
games.summary:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

games.name: Tobari and the Vampire Alchemist
games.summary: Guide the protagonist through the maps. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster, Tobari. Driven by hidden motives that outweigh the danger, the alchemist suffers from an illness. Beside them, the monster finds its heart torn by strange, conflicting emotions...

games.name: Tonin
games.summary: Slice and kick your enemies away! An open-world Japanese-style × Sci-Fi slash action game!

games.name: Tricky and the Dream Caster
games.summary:
Tricky O'Possum has been hit with a sleep curse, trapping him in Caster's dream domain!
With the help of his new pal Volt, he's gotta collect the keys to Caster's Castle and beat him up to break the curse.
Utilize Tricky's expressive, free-form moveset to explore the various worlds of the Astral Plane, all inspired by the library of a certain ill-fated 6th gen console.

games.name: Trivals
games.summary: A multiplayer sport where the goal adapts to stop you. No aim assist. No randomness. Just ball physics, hero abilities, and a target that gets harder to break the closer you get to winning.

games.name: Tsarevna: Age of Tales
games.summary: The world’s first ballet-inspired action slasher! Where grace turns into violence and revenge consumes the soul. Master breathtaking, fluid combat, slaughter the servants of Darkness, and step into the war against the Slavic gods.

games.name: Tutankhamun: Builders of the Eternal
games.summary: A 3D city-builder where you farm the Nile, worship powerful gods, train armies, trade with distant regions, and construct monumental works worthy of ancient Egypt.

games.name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
games.summary: Fantasy Point & Click Horror Drama: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you seek the truth of magic’s birth, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

games.name: Under a Groove
games.summary: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.summary:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

games.name: Up ' N ' Up: Mountain Express
games.summary:
Deliver mail up the side of a mountain upgrading your 4WD as you go.
Like an arcade Mudrunners with a roguelike twist.

games.name: Vaska
games.summary: Meet Vaska — a cat lost in a strange and dangerous forest... Move quietly, hide, solve puzzles, and find your way home!

games.name: Victor's Video Vault
games.summary: It's 1995. The video store is alive. When the last customer leaves, the final rental rewrites reality.

games.name: Virtua Fighter Crossroads
games.summary: The newest installment in the Virtua Fighter series, releasing in 2027.

games.name: Vivarium
games.summary: You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

games.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
games.summary: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

games.name: Wandersky
games.summary: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

games.name: Wardens of Avalon
games.summary: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

games.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
games.summary: Play a sneaky & brutal Skaven Assassin in this new, refreshing but gritty take on the 2D Action platformer genre.

games.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
games.summary: Players control Kaatri, a veteran warrior who forms a pact with an otherworldly entity to wield dark magic against formidable foes. The game focuses on open-world exploration, visceral combat blending melee and spell-casting, and the thematic cost of power.

games.name: Waterful
games.summary: A peaceful nature-builder where you dig riverbeds to guide water through tiny desert valleys. Grow a variety of plants and discover all the animals drawn to the new habitats. Complete quests and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!

games.name: We Grew Up in War
games.summary: Discover the stories of kids growing up in the midst of armed conflicts over the last three decades. Inspired by real testimonies, this narrative adventure follows the lives of children from Bosnia, Syria, and Ukraine.

games.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn
games.summary: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Wild Chorus
games.summary: An adventure game, but you play musical instruments instead of swinging swords. Gather adorable Sound Sprites, cut through the looming Silence, and rebuild the soundtrack of this hand-illustrated world in whatever way you see fit. No musical ability required!

games.name: Wired Tokyo
games.summary:
— Dive into Tokyo. Dive into the past. —
WIRED TOKYO is a vertical 3D action game where you climb toward the vast skies above Tokyo.
To unlock new abilities, you may have to deliberately “dive” from above.
A climbing game where falling has meaning — that’s WIRED TOKYO.

games.name: Witches Craft
games.summary: Witches Craft is an adult adventure & crafting game following Selene; A fully trained Hedge Witch and Aspiring Alchemist.

games.name: Witherheart
games.summary: Witherheart is a turn-based roguelike deck-building game with grid-based combat. Build your deck, reposition on the battlefield, and make tactical decisions where every card and every step can turn the tide of a fight.

games.name: World Railway
games.summary: In World Railway, a sim management game, you're a conductor reviving a rundown train. Produce and gather resources via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

games.name: WorldShards
games.summary: WorldShards is a Sandbox-RPG with a levelless progress system. Explore the mysterious fantasy world of Murrlandia, solve its mysteries, and help its tiny inhabitants to rebuild their home!

games.name: Xenoblade Genesis
games.summary: A new beginning for the Xenoblade series is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

games.name: Yakoh: Shinobi Ops
games.summary: Four Shinobi lurking in the darkness. Silent as shadows, racing through the night. To complete their deadly mission, they master their arts—hiding, sparing lives, deceiving—as they venture toward either death or salvation. Evade the relentless pursuit of immortal Hunters, and only by returning alive will their mission be fulfilled.

games.name: Zehlar
games.summary: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.
